reason: 该插件主要用途是将 DeepSeek Harness 中关键交互事件（如用户审批、提问、计划确认和会话结束）转换为飞书机器人消息推送，属于外部服务事件通知型能力，而非通用开发或内容处理功能。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 运行过程中推送用户审批、提问和会话结束等事件提醒到用户配置的飞书机器人。
summaries.en: This plugin sends notifications from DeepSeek Harness events such as approvals, user questions, and turn completion to a user-configured Feishu bot.

capabilities: sends outbound webhook notifications to an external service
monitors DeepSeek Harness interaction lifecycle events
stores user-provided webhook configuration in host settings

reasons.code: README states the plugin sends text notifications to a Feishu bot when user-approval, ask-user-question, plan-confirmation, and turn-end events occur.
README explains users configure a Feishu custom robot Webhook in settings, and that the value is persisted via host API into the DSH settings file.
package.json includes DSH bundle/client configuration and runtime entries, confirming it is an integration plugin intended for the DeepSeek Harness web profile.
